title: Decoding the Genomic Landscape of Premature Ovarian Insufficiency: From Mechanisms to Targeted Therapies
description: A synthesis of the latest genomic discoveries in Premature Ovarian Insufficiency (POI), leveraging large-scale sequencing and association studies that have identified over 90 genes. The review explores foundational genetic concepts, advanced methodologies like Mendelian randomization and single-cell multi-omics for identifying novel drug targets, and addresses challenges of genetic heterogeneity. It provides a comprehensive resource for understanding the molecular etiology of POI and outlines a translational roadmap for developing targeted interventions.
